profile.input_contract: OpenMOC pincell case parameters and cross-section perturbation fields.

mrs.description: Scaling the fuel material's nu-sigma-f cross section by factor > 1 must monotonically increase the dominant eigenvalue k_eff of the OpenMOC neutron-transport solution.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: Scaling the fuel material's nu-sigma-f cross section by factor > 1 must monotonically increase the dominant eigenvalue k_eff of the OpenMOC neutron-transport solution.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleNuSigmaF via transform steps [ScaleField@/materials/fuel/nu_sigma_f] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `k_eff` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `openmoc-pincell-nu-sigma-f`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `greater` / `GreaterThan` checks the expected relation on `k_eff`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `openmoc` exposes sample `sample/pincell.json`, the transform target fields, and output `k_eff`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.

mrs.display_name: OpenMOC pin-cell — RefineRayTracks (k_eff error decreases toward reference)
mrs.description: OpenMOC angular-discretization convergence: refining num_azim and azim_spacing_cm via three calibrated phases (16/0.05 → 48/0.0166667 → 128/0.00625) drives k_eff error toward the most-refined reference on the canonical pin-cell case. Error is computed under NormKind.Relative; the assertion passes iff |k_eff(medium)−k_eff(reference)| ≤ |k_eff(coarse)−k_eff(reference)|.
